description: Steam leaked from the top of the door seal during a Bowie-Dick test cycle.
root_cause: Worn door seal no longer sealed against the door.
action_taken: Replaced the door seal, tested function and operation, returned to service.

description: Water leaking from the sterilizer onto the floor.
root_cause: Door gasket and door seal worn out.
action_taken: Took the unit out of service, replaced the door gasket and door seal, tested and returned to service.

description: Water leaking from around the door seal, in front of the door and into the floor below.
root_cause: Debris around the door seal and in the door seal channel stopped the seal seating.
action_taken: Cleaned debris from the door seal and seal channel, tested; no part replaced. Last preventive maintenance 5 months earlier had found no leaks.

description: Steam leaking around the door as soon as the sterilizer was switched on.
root_cause: Worn valves in the drain system did not open, so water stayed in the chamber; when heated it turned to steam and escaped past a worn door seal.
action_taken: Repaired the drain system, replaced the door seal, ran a test cycle and returned to service.

description: Mid-cycle, steam burst out around the door and filled the room.
root_cause: Damaged door gasket. Likely premature wear or replacement overdue: the maker's manual says inspect the door gasket quarterly and replace it every six months.
action_taken: Replaced the door gasket, aligned the door, replaced faulty door hardware, ran verification tests and returned to service.

description: Steam leaking from the sterilizer. Maintenance shut off air and steam to the unit.
root_cause: Solenoid valve on the door gasket regulator was leaking: its S-36 cap had unscrewed.
action_taken: Rebuilt the solenoid valve, replaced the cap, ran test cycles and returned to service.

description: Alarm "too long to unseal" and hot water leaking at the door; the door seal stayed out.
root_cause: Air manifold fault kept valve V37 from opening, so the door seal did not retract.
action_taken: Replaced valve V37, tested and returned to service. Let the sterilizer cool before touching the door seal: hot condensate can spray out.

area_or_equipment: Steam sterilizer, STERIS Century 20-inch, with steam generator
description: Sterilizer alarming "door unsealed"; it was out of use until later the same day.
root_cause: The door seal needs steam above 10 psig. A holed heating element in the steam generator shorted the contactor and tripped the 100 A breaker, so there was no steam for the seal.
action_taken: Replaced the heating element and the contactor, confirmed the unit operational.

area_or_equipment: Steam sterilizer, STERIS Century, with steam generator
description: Sterilizer alarmed "door unsealed" and steam leaked from the unit.
root_cause: Steam generator boiler overfilled because a clogged fill probe sent intermittent signals to the generator control board. Generator control pressure had been set above 100 psi instead of 90 psi.
action_taken: Replaced the generator control and valves and returned to service. The generator control pressure should be 90 psi.

description: Positive biological indicator in a load; instruments reprocessed and one procedure cancelled.
root_cause: Poor leak rate: deteriorated chamber exhaust valve body and a leak in the exhaust piping. The solenoid, check valves, door seal and door seal pressure switch also needed replacing.
action_taken: Replaced the exhaust valve parts, solenoid, check valves, door seal and door seal pressure switch, ran test cycles and confirmed it operational.

description: Sterilizer leaking steam; condensate pooled on the floor.
root_cause: The gasket on steam manifold valve S2 was out of position, so the valve stayed open and let excess steam out. Unit was 12 years old.
action_taken: Rebuilt valve S2, tested and returned to service.

description: Water flooded out of the sterilizer into the room and the corridor.
root_cause: Worn gasket on the steam generator heater element; the heater contactor was chattering.
action_taken: Replaced the heater element gasket and the contactor, confirmed the unit operational.

area_or_equipment: Steam sterilizer, STERIS Century 20-inch, with steam generator
description: Water flooded from the steam generator onto the floor.
root_cause: Steam generator flooded with the sight glass full; high pressure set point switch had tripped; small steam leaks at the heater flange and the sight glass.
action_taken: Replaced the heater element gasket, refitted the heater, reassembled the sight glass, ran test cycles.

description: Sterilizer leaking water onto the floor and not operating.
root_cause: Damaged gasket in the sight glass.
action_taken: Repaired the sight glass with a repair kit, tested and returned to service.

description: Water leaking and alarm "too long to exhaust".
root_cause: Broken baffle on the drain tank blocked the drain hole; water backed up, damaged the heat exchanger, entered the chamber and broke the door seal. The site did its own maintenance.
action_taken: Replaced the baffle, drain tank, heat exchanger, door seal and safety valves; tested and returned to service.

description: Door hard to open and close; the handwheel was very stiff to turn.
root_cause: Dirty door seal, worn ball bearings and radial arms not engaging. The maintenance manual asks for hinge lubrication 6 times a year and greasing the door post and bearings once a year.
action_taken: Replaced the door seal, ball bearings and radial arms; lubricated the door lock mechanism; returned to service.

description: One sterilizer failed a Bowie-Dick test; the next day the second failed too and had a torn door gasket. Parts were replaced in both, but Bowie-Dick results got worse. Both sterilizers were down.
root_cause: Not the sterilizers: users left the Bowie-Dick pack on a metal case cart that stayed in the chamber across cycles, heating the chamber and reducing the steam the indicator needs.
action_taken: Replaced the torn gasket and aligned the door. The service engineer confirmed calibration; users now remove the case cart before the test. Bowie-Dick and biological indicators then passed.
